policies.notes: Ticket PRs target integration and require independent review plus fresh CI. Only Jon release-merges integration into main. Review policy holds unreviewed PRs; an independent agent review is not an owner listening or license act. T01 is the pre-specified broad foundation ticket; package scaffolding, gates and generated registry/mission files are reviewed together. Later feature changes retain small ticket boundaries. November 6 owner amendment authorizes integration squash merges after green current-head CI and independent current-base review. Server-side branch protection is not required; repository stays private. Main remains owner-release-only. Merged code is distinct from pending full acceptance.
